pack.title: Hotel Front Office — Japanese
pack.description: Very polite Japanese phrases for front desk staff serving hotel guests.
pack.generated_by: Qonverse sample pack (please have a native speaker review before real use)

scenarios.title: Check-in
scenarios.context: Greeting arriving guests and finding their booking.

in_a_sentence.text: ご予約のお名前をお願いいたします。
in_a_sentence.romanization: Go-yoyaku no o-namae o onegai itashimasu.
in_a_sentence.meaning: May I have the name on your booking, please?

phrases.when_to_use: When a guest arrives to check in and you need to find their reservation.
phrases.notes: The extra ご and お make it very polite.

example.setting: A guest walks up to the front desk with their luggage.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: いらっしゃいませ。ご予約のお名前をお願いいたします。
dialogue.romanization: Irasshaimase. Go-yoyaku no o-namae o onegai itashimasu.
dialogue.meaning: Welcome. May I have the name on your booking?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 田中様ですね。少々お待ちくださいませ。
dialogue.romanization: Tanaka-sama desu ne. Shōshō omachi kudasaimase.

likely_responses.text: 会社の名前で予約しました。
likely_responses.romanization: Kaisha no namae de yoyaku shimashita.
likely_responses.meaning: I booked under my company's name.

in_a_sentence.text: ただいまお調べしますので、少々お待ちください。
in_a_sentence.romanization: Tadaima o-shirabe shimasu node, shōshō omachi kudasai.
in_a_sentence.meaning: I'll check right now, so one moment, please.

phrases.when_to_use: Any time you need the guest to wait briefly, such as while you look up their booking.
phrases.notes: For extra politeness say 少々お待ちくださいませ (shōshō omachi kudasaimase).

example.setting: You are searching the system for a guest's reservation.

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.meaning: I'm Yamamoto, I have a booking.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: ありがとうございます。少々お待ちください。

in_a_sentence.text: パスポートを拝見してもよろしいでしょうか。
in_a_sentence.romanization: Pasupōto o haiken shite mo yoroshii deshō ka.

phrases.when_to_use: When registering a foreign guest, who must show their passport.
phrases.notes: 拝見 (haiken) is the humble word for 'see'. Take the passport with both hands.

example.setting: You have found the booking and need to register the guest.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: パスポートを拝見してもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.romanization: Pasupōto o haiken shite mo yoroshii deshō ka.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: ありがとうございます。

likely_responses.text: 部屋に置いてきました。
likely_responses.meaning: I left it in my room.

in_a_sentence.text: 朝食会場は2階でございます。
in_a_sentence.romanization: Chōshoku kaijō wa ni-kai de gozaimasu.
in_a_sentence.meaning: The breakfast room is on the 2nd floor.

phrases.when_to_use: When a guest asks where breakfast is served.

example.setting: A guest asks about breakfast while you hand over the key card.

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.text: 朝ごはんはどこですか。

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 朝食会場は2階でございます。7時から10時までです。
dialogue.romanization: Chōshoku kaijō wa ni-kai de gozaimasu. Shichi-ji kara jū-ji made desu.
dialogue.meaning: The breakfast room is on the 2nd floor. It's from 7 to 10.

likely_responses.text: 料金に含まれていますか。
likely_responses.meaning: Is it included in the rate?

scenarios.title: Check-out
scenarios.context: Settling the bill and saying goodbye.

in_a_sentence.text: こちらがお会計でございます。

phrases.when_to_use: When you hand the guest their bill at check-out.

example.setting: A guest returns the key card and wants to check out.

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.text: チェックアウトをお願いします。
dialogue.meaning: I'd like to check out, please.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: かしこまりました。こちらがお会計でございます。
dialogue.romanization: Kashikomarimashita. Kochira ga o-kaikei de gozaimasu.

likely_responses.text: これは何の料金ですか。
likely_responses.romanization: Kore wa nan no ryōkin desu ka.

in_a_sentence.text: お支払い方法はいかがなさいますか。
in_a_sentence.romanization: O-shiharai hōhō wa ikaga nasaimasu ka.
in_a_sentence.meaning: How would you like to pay?

phrases.when_to_use: After showing the bill, to ask how the guest will pay.

example.setting: The guest has checked the bill and nods.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: お支払い方法はいかがなさいますか。
dialogue.romanization: O-shiharai hōhō wa ikaga nasaimasu ka.
dialogue.meaning: How would you like to pay?

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.text: カードでお願いします。

likely_responses.text: カードでお願いします。

in_a_sentence.text: お荷物をお預かりいたしましょうか。
in_a_sentence.meaning: Shall we keep your luggage for you?

phrases.when_to_use: When a checked-out guest still has time before leaving the city.

example.setting: The guest mentions they will go sightseeing before their flight.

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.meaning: I'll go sightseeing until the evening.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: お荷物をお預かりいたしましょうか。
dialogue.meaning: Shall we keep your luggage for you?

likely_responses.text: 何時まで預けられますか。
likely_responses.meaning: Until what time can I leave it?

phrases.text: またのお越しをお待ちしております
phrases.romanization: mata no okoshi o omachi shite orimasu
phrases.meaning: we look forward to your next visit

in_a_sentence.text: ご利用ありがとうございました。またのお越しをお待ちしております。
in_a_sentence.romanization: Go-riyō arigatō gozaimashita. Mata no okoshi o omachi shite orimasu.
in_a_sentence.meaning: Thank you for staying with us. We look forward to your next visit.

phrases.when_to_use: The standard farewell as the guest leaves the desk.
phrases.notes: A fixed farewell expression, said with a bow.

example.setting: Check-out is complete and the guest picks up their bag.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: ご利用ありがとうございました。またのお越しをお待ちしております。
dialogue.romanization: Go-riyō arigatō gozaimashita. Mata no okoshi o omachi shite orimasu.
dialogue.meaning: Thank you for staying with us. We look forward to your next visit.

likely_responses.text: ありがとうございました。
